Marssenger Kitchenware (Simplified Chinese: 火星人厨具) is a Chinese supplier of kitchen appliances. It was founded in 2010 in Haining, Zhejiang and went public in 2020 in Shenzhen Exchange. Marssenger offers integrated stoves, integrated dishwashers, sink dishwashers, integrated sinks, water heaters, and integrated home appliances. Marssenger is the largest producer of integrated kitchen appliances in China.
History
Zhejiang Marssenger Kitchenware was established in 2010. The first franchised outlet opened in 2011.
In 2013, the Marssenger X7 integrated stove won the iF Design Gold Award. In July, it received the Red Dot Award from Germany. From 2014, Marssenger has won the "High-Tech Enterprise" certificate in China 4 times.
In June 2015, the Marssenger X2 integrated stove with steam box was launched.
In March 2016, Marssenger integrated stoves received a notarized statement stating 'Capable of absorbing oil fumes from stir-frying 100 chili peppers'. In 2016, Marssenger completed its shareholding reform and was renamed Marssenger Kitchenware Co., Ltd.
As of June 2021, Marssenger  had over 1,900 dealer stores in China.
